title: If Enzo Fernandez leaves Chelsea permanently during the 2026 summer transfer window, which club will sign him?
background: Fernandez is a Chelsea midfielder. This question concerns a permanent transfer rather than a loan.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official club announcements or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera Sport, confirming a completed transfer. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the club that completes Fernandez's permanent transfer from Chelsea during the 2026 summer transfer window. A reported bid, agreement in principle, or loan does not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the acquiring club.
